csv_project_name: Developer for Quantum University of Houston
csv_scope_of_work: UNIVERSITY OF HOUSTON SYSTEM UH and/or Owner , for the use and benefit of the University of Houston is conducting a competitive TWO-STEP Request for Qualifications RFQ process to retain ONE Firm or Joint Venture ( JV ) to provide Master Development Services for the Quantum at the University of Houston Project . Respondents are required to identify and submit the complete project team, inclusive of design consultants and the construction general manager, as part of their initial proposal. While UH maintains flexibility regarding the composition of the proposing Firm or Joint Venture ( JV ), it is anticipated that the selected developer may supplement the team with additional expertise as project requirements evolve.
